segments.name: Low risk: normal blood pressure, good general health
segments.action: General prevention messaging and routine re-screening every few years.

segments.name: Moderate risk: high blood pressure, no mobility limits
segments.action: Offer a blood-sugar test at the next routine visit and refer to a diet-and-activity prevention programme.

segments.name: High risk: walking difficulty, many poor physical-health days
segments.action: Priority outreach: offer an HbA1c or fasting-glucose test now and link positives to clinical care — plus physical-activity promotion, low-impact or home-based exercise options.

segments.name: Low risk: heavy drinkers, smokers
segments.action: General prevention messaging and routine re-screening every few years — plus a brief alcohol intervention.
